special_regions.finding: Validated data/mask containment and complete source-grid census in bound mask; independent A02/A15 observed boundary anchor on tour. No assertion of surveyed geographic precision or every boundary pixel.

Validated retained physical source geometries, declared subpixel omissions, measured mask/SDF contour samples and independently viewed V02 regression. Bound source fidelity, not every real coastline or every GPU fragment.
Single canonical source raster + independent actual patch-edge/midpoint query correspondence and invisible logical tile probes. Runtime sampled seams only, no global GPU edge/IO topology guarantee.

nodata.description: Eleven unavailable WorldCover sourceCOGs intersect only non-land at canonical census resolution.
nodata.treatment: NEphysical land/lakes supplies explicit waterdomain. No landcoverunknown cells remain in full canonical census. This is resolution-bound, not proof of every tiny island.

landcover_treatments.rationale: Homogeneous natural-looking material, no source color textures, field geometry, plantation rows, streets or built objects. WorldCover does not separately identify every managed forest or transport class; no reconstruction of untouched natural vegetation. Independent A10 image/inventory review confirms this visible abstraction in the considered source classes and captured regions; WorldCover cannot distinguish every plantation/natural forest. Any earlier A08 style finding belongs to the named historical review; current renderer/style acceptance requires its separate matching review.
